items.title: National park becomes known as the 'Devil's Triangle'

children.content: Barrington Tops National Park in NSW has claimed nine planes and 30 lives in the past eight decades. Only four people have ever walked away, and one of those is pilot Dennis Hume, who was forced to eject from his plane and plunge thousands of metres into its unforgiving forest ranges.

image.altText: The shadowed outline of a plane is superimposed over the shape of a triangle, the forest of Barrington Tops in the background.
